title: Rabbi Yehudah HaKohen
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Mishnah Eduyot 8:2, testifying with Rabbi Yehudah ben Bava concerning a minor Israelite girl, etc. Hyman suggests that possibly he is the son of Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai mentioned in Niddah 15a, where he disagrees with Rabbi Akiva.

notes.text: The consulted Eduyot and Niddah passages supply the two respective designations. Their identification is Hyman’s conjecture.
